record_title: Single commutators and trace rigidity in norm reduced products of finite von Neumann algebras
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: This is a structural consequence of the 2026 uniform finite-von-Neumann commutator theorem, not a new proof of that theorem. Matrix norm ultraproducts already have older pseudomatricial trace-rigidity and self-adjoint self-commutator results. The claim is restricted to operator-norm reduced products/ultraproducts and does not address arbitrary C*-ultraproducts or 2-norm tracial ultraproducts.
